This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I1, which 
must be carried out 
every 3 months as indicated in the above title block by M3. 
The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 8/5/02 for Matar circuit no. 1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, 
Cairo zone.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety robe and precaution marks must be used
Wearing helmet and safety harnesses is necessary

Switch on the earthing switch and check mechanical interlocking with the 
 disconnect or

Clean porcelain 
 surfaces from dust, dirties, deposits ... etc

Remove the old 
 grease out of the blades and contacts of disconnect switch and put new thin 
 film of new grease

Tighten bolts 
 and nuts of disconnect switch

Clean the gear 
 box of disconnect switch and then grease it

Clean the blade 
 of earthing switch (that engages with disconnect switch)

Clean and grease 
 the gear box of earthing switch

Inspect the 
 marshalling box of the disconnect switch, remove dust, then clean auxiliary 
 switch, limit switch, push buttons, etc ... with video cleaner also check its 
 gasket to be sealed to prevent dust from going inside

Repeat previous 
 step (7) for earthing switch marshalling box

Grease the 
 horizontal axis of disconnect switch

Inspect the 
 operating arms and its hinges, and grease the hinges

text:
Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I1, which 
must be carried out 
every 3 months as indicated in the above title block by M3. 
The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 8/5/02 for Matar circuit no. 1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, 
Cairo zone.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety robe and precaution marks must be used
Wearing helmet and safety harnesses is necessary
Switch on the earthing switch and check mechanical interlocking with the 
 disconnect or
Switch off DC source
Environmental Precautions
Tools and Equipments
Suitable tool 
 set
Pieces of 
 clothes and rags
Grease and 
 cleaning liquid (like gasoline)
Safety 
 harness, helmet, breathing mask
Work to be carried out
Clean porcelain 
 surfaces from dust, dirties, deposits ... etc
Remove the old 
 grease out of the blades and contacts of disconnect switch and put new thin 
 film of new grease
Tighten bolts 
 and nuts of disconnect switch
Clean the gear 
 box of disconnect switch and then grease it
Clean the blade 
 of earthing switch (that engages with disconnect switch)
Clean and grease 
 the gear box of earthing switch
Inspect the 
 marshalling box of the disconnect switch, remove dust, then clean auxiliary 
 switch, limit switch, push buttons, etc ... with video cleaner also check its 
 gasket to be sealed to prevent dust from going inside
Repeat previous 
 step (7) for earthing switch marshalling box
Grease the 
 horizontal axis of disconnect switch
Inspect the 
 operating arms and its hinges, and grease the hinges
